answer: Commit-reveal bond stops farms: each identity files its task-history kernel in an atlas and locks a 70-credit bond. It must reveal the matching history before the horizon closes or lose it. Auditors replay the atlas, and a missing reveal or shared kernel burns the bond. Each fake pays 40 plus 70 locked, so 1,000 fakes pay 110,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented kernels reveal once. Honest agents pay 40 once and reclaim the bond after a clean horizon.
